content:
We have a new stable release of Lean, v4.35.0! See the release notes for more information.

The usual repos are all available with the new toolchain at their respective v4.35.0 tags (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.116). We encourage all projects downstream to update to v4.35.0 when possible, and to release their own corresponding toolchain tags after updating.

Claude says:

Corrections to the release notes: they give the backward option for the instance-search change as backward.isDefEq.instanceTypes, which doesn't exist. The real name is backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.instanceSearchTypes, which Lean registers and Mathlib uses.

(I've had it digest the notes to prepare for upgrading...)
